title: Information Access of the Oppressed: A Problem-Posing Framework for Envisioning Emancipatory Information Access Platforms
reasoning: The paper develops a framework based on Paulo Freire’s 'Pedagogy of the Oppressed' to evaluate information access platforms and AI models. It focuses extensively on epistemic justice, emancipatory ethics, and the sociotechnical values required to resist authoritarian capture, situating itself within critical theory and normative ethics.
